instructions.providerClientRef: Non-secret stable FANDEX reference for the exact Google Cloud project/client. Do not paste API keys.
instructions.googleCloudProjectNumber: Exact numeric Google Cloud project number.
instructions.googleCloudProjectId: Optional Google Cloud project id; null if not known.
instructions.credentialLocatorRef: Secret locator only, for example github-actions-secret://FANDEX_SNS_FANDOM_YOUTUBE_API_KEY. Never paste the credential value.
instructions.cloudProjectEvidenceRef: Non-secret evidence reference that proves the project/client binding.
